Card Q&A.a: This effect triggers and can be activated when a Digimon specified by it leaves the battle area under the specified conditions.When activated, all Digimon matching its trigger conditions are prevented from leaving.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's [All Turns] effect do, exactly?

Effect: When this card would be played, if your opponent has 2 or more Digimon, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Return all of your opponent's Digimon with the fewest digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, it may unsuspend.

[All Turns] When any of your Digimon with the [TS] trait or [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of their traits would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by suspending this Digimon, they don't leave.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any trait or w/[TS] trait: Cost 3
